about.body: The AJ25 is a V6 (60° angle), 2.5L (2,495 cc), Petrol engine used across Jaguar's several model range, in production 2001–2009. We rebuild every AJ25 to original specification, replacing worn timing components, bearings, gaskets and seals as standard.

byModel.body: The AJ25 is deployed across the AJ25 (AJ25 / AJ25, AJ25), the AJ25 (AJ25 / AJ25, AJ25), and the AJ25 (AJ25 / AJ25, AJ25). These form the core of the high-performance AJ25 range. More recently, the engine has been adopted for the AJ25 (AJ25, AJ25), the AJ25 (AJ25, AJ25), and the AJ25 roadster (AJ25, AJ25), proving the AJ25's versatility across different vehicle types.

compatibility.body: Because the AJ25 is fitted to six different models — from the compact AJ25 to the grand-touring AJ25 roadster — compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation, and specific exact variant (e.g., "45" vs "45 S" vs "43"). A AJ25 from an AJ25 isn't a drop-in match for a AJ25 from an AJ25 — ancillaries and mounting differ.
